# PRAXO-CORE

> Governed, embeddable multi-language agent framework. Go is the reference
> implementation; Python, TypeScript, Java, Rust, C#, R, Ruby, PHP, Elixir, Lua,
> and other implementations ship independent packages. This file is a
> machine-readable entry point for coding tools; it does not guarantee discovery,
> installation, or adoption.

## Start

- [README](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/README.md): positioning, install, and repository map.
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/docs/getting-started/quickstart.md): run a first agent from a checkout.
- [Examples](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/docs/getting-started/examples.md): task-oriented and language-organized example catalog.
- [Examples directory](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/examples/README.md): Go, Workspace, HTTP service, and cross-language examples.
- [Live model](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/language/go/examples/live-model/README.md): published-package OpenAI-compatible path.
- [Start Here](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/docs/getting-started/index.md): task-oriented selection guidance.
- [When Not To Use](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/docs/getting-started/when-not-to-use.md): explicit non-goals before selecting Core.

## Coding Agents

- [Coding-agent integration contract](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/docs/getting-started/coding-agents.md): package map, explicit tool scope, final-argument authorization, denial tests, and verification commands.
- [Machine-readable package map](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/docs/getting-started/agent-integration.json): current recommended versions and starter paths.
- [Skill template](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/agent-skills/praxo-integration/SKILL.md): optional tool-neutral workflow; installation and discovery are not guaranteed.

## Boundaries and Evidence

- [Public roadmap](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/docs/project/roadmap.md): acceptance stages and compatibility commitments.
- [Execution profiles](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/docs/reference/execution-profiles.md): Standard Embedding, Governed Execution, and Embodied Integration boundaries.
- [Execution Correctness Suite](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/docs/project/execution-correctness.md): EC-01 through EC-14 and EC-D/EC-I/EC-O tracks.
- [Verification evidence](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/docs/project/verification-evidence.md): claim levels, current results, and limits.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history and compatibility notes.

## Do Not Infer

Core fixtures and consumer tests do not prove live-model quality, authentic
identity, durable approvals, external effect commit, exactly-once execution,
sandbox isolation, physical safety, or real-time control. A checkpoint is a
recovery hint, not a transaction.
